jobs.title: Product Design Manager (Group Lead)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ferocia

Ferocia is a team of more than 300 people building better financial experiences for Australians.

As the digital division of Bendigo Bank, our work spans Up, a digital bank; Connect, the platform powering Bendigo Bank’s web and mobile banking; and tools that make managing money simpler and help protect people from scams and fraud.

Our shared purpose: helping people feel more confident and in control of their money.

Sound like something you’d like to be part of? We’d love to hear from you.

 

The role

This is a rare opportunity to join a small team and have a real impact on people's lives by helping Australians build savings habits and feel in control of their home ownership journey.

We're looking for an experienced designer to lead design for 2 of our teams. It's a player-coach role: part strategic Principal Product Designer, part Design Manager. You'll frame the direction and future opportunities for these areas while supporting and managing the 2 Senior Product Designers embedded in the engineering teams. You will own the quality bar, and stay close enough to the craft to lift the experience yourself.

You'll wear many hats, balancing strategy with execution. On a typical day you could be:

  • Leading the vision: defining the design direction and future experience for your areas, and contributing to strategy and roadmaps alongside the Head of Design, Head of Product/PMs and Engineering Director/EMs.

  • Setting the context: translating company and product strategy for your team, framing the why and how behind the work, and holding the balance between detail and big picture.

  • Coaching the team: mentoring and supporting your designers so they grow, and making sure the team ships high-craft work efficiently.

  • Designing: producing high-fidelity designs and prototypes for the largest, highest-impact projects.

  • Building the team: identifying future roles based on workload and priorities, and leading the hiring process.

  • Shaping the design org: working with the Design Leadership Team on culture, strategy, shared processes and org-level problems.

  • Joining the dots: working with Brand, Marketing and Support so the experience is consistent across every touchpoint.

What we're looking for

  • Experience leading and successfully delivering major projects - with at least 8 years working with product teams (ideally on a SaaS or consumer product, and even better if it's in Fin-Tech), or within a digital agency.

  • People leadership experience - having successfully mentored or managed a small team of designers.

  • Creativity and craftsmanship - strong interaction and visual skills. We really pride ourselves in the way we present experiences and the emotional responses we seek from our users.

  • Problem solving skills and a strong product lens - the ability to understand customer needs, motivations and behaviours, and to know how to translate this understanding into product opportunities. Being able to think holistically about end to end experiences, and design solutions that fit into a complex ecosystem.

  • Collaboration and communication skills - the ability to articulate ideas effectively and provide sound reasoning for decisions, and to use storytelling to inform and influence.

  • Passion - harder to define, but we're looking for people who have a desire to push the limits, break the status quo, and be at the forefront of where technology is leading us. An eagerness to learn, expand your skills, and do the best work possible.

  • Technical knowledge, especially front-end, and a solid understanding of an agile engineering development process. Comfortable with complex technical problems.

  • Ability to work with a certain level of ambiguity, and "get shit done" autonomously - we operate like a start-up and things can often be messy, undefined, or change at the last minute. We're looking for someone who enjoys innovative fast paced work environments and tackling all sort of problems.

Interview process

More details will be provided on application, but all applicants will go through the same stages:

  1. Intro chat and career review with Sylvain (Head of Design) — 30min

  2. Presentation of case studies for a deep dive into your work and your design skill. With Sylvain (Head of Design) and 2 Product Design Managers — 60min

  3. Presentation of case studies focused on strategic shaping and leadership skills. With a Design Manager, a Senior Designer, and a PM — 60min

  4. Interview focused on leadership and management experience with Head of Product and General Manager.

  5. References check

  6. Offer

Applying

When applying, make sure to attach a portfolio or have a link in your CV to demonstrate your skills and some examples of work you’ve produced.

Working at Ferocia

We work flexibly, with genuine autonomy over where and when you do your best work. Ferocians can use our Melbourne CBD office as much or as little as makes sense for them.

We also value spending time together face to face, with teams making time to meet in person when it matters. That’s why we’re currently only hiring people based in Naarm/Melbourne and surrounding areas.

Here’s some of what you can expect:

  • Smart, passionate people who care about what they make.

  • Generous leave and parental policies.

  • Flexibility and genuine autonomy over your time.

  • A great CBD office with a rooftop, gym and personal trainer.

  • A budget for personal development, training and conferences.

  • An Employee Assistance Program.

  • Home loan rebates (conditions apply).

  • Ongoing bonus and equity grants (conditions apply).

Unsure if you tick every box? Throw your hat in the ring anyway. We value different experiences and perspectives, so we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. You might be just who we’re looking for.

jobs.title: Account Verification and Fraud Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ferocia

Ferocia is a team of more than 300 people building better financial experiences for Australians.

As the digital division of Bendigo Bank, our work spans Up, a digital bank; Connect, the platform powering Bendigo Bank’s web and mobile banking; and tools that make managing money simpler and help protect people from scams and fraud.

Our shared purpose: helping people feel more confident and in control of their money.

Sound like something you’d like to be part of? We’d love to hear from you.

 

The gig

We're looking for a sharp, proactive Account Verification and Fraud Specialist to join our Fraud Prevention Customer Support Team at Up. If you're passionate about safeguarding customers and staying one step ahead of fraud, this is your chance to make a real impact. You’ll be diving into account verification cases and combating fraudsters head-on from mules to scammers, verifying identity documents, and collaborating with your team to refine processes and enhance our in-house tools.

With a high volume of risk-related tasks, the Fraud Prevention and Customer Support team needs to stay cool under pressure while keeping a strong grasp of our ever-evolving in-house systems and customer needs. Success in this role requires the ability to strategically prioritise tasks and adapt to shifting priorities.

What you'll do

  • Customer Support:

    • Provide top-notch support for customers involved in scams and/or account security situations across chat and phone functions.

    • Engage with customers from all walks of life, providing clear and empathetic support while embodying our four support values: Be quick, be a mate, be an expert, be Up!

  • Risk Assessment and Management:

    • Apply existing risk management processes for the safety of customers and the business.

    • Recommend improvements of fraud risk assessment and prevention procedures.

    • Stay updated on emerging fraud trends and threats to proactively address potential risks.

    • Liaise with internal stake holders to provide efficient customer outcomes.

  • ID Verification:

    • Verify customer identities using a range of methods and technologies.

    • Handle sensitive data with care and maintain confidentiality.

    • Keep up with the latest trends and tech in ID verification to enhance our processes.

  • Know Your Customer (KYC):

    • Verify customer information to comply with legal and regulatory standards.

    • Check and confirm the accuracy and authenticity of customer documents.

    • Stay up-to-date with KYC regulations and best practices.

What we're looking for

Someone who:

  • Has previous experience in banking or financial services, particularly in KYC compliance, customer fraud resolution, or a similar role.

  • Is Melbourne based and keen to work from our Collins Street (Melbourne CBD) office as often as possible.

  • Can work fluctuating shifts throughout the week (our support team work between 6am and 12am seven days a week).

  • Feels comfortable giving and receiving feedback with their teammates.

  • Embraces accountability, values quality, and is always looking to improve.

  • Juggles multiple tasks effortlessly - staying cool under pressure.

  • Loves pushing boundaries and challenging the status quo.

  • Builds strong relationships - whether it’s with teammates or cross-functional teams to drive great customer outcomes. You understand the power of connections and being known within the company.

  • Is eager to dive into our company culture and be part of something bigger.

Working at Ferocia

We work flexibly, with genuine autonomy over where and when you do your best work. Ferocians can use our Melbourne CBD office as much or as little as makes sense for them.

We also value spending time together face to face, with teams making time to meet in person when it matters. That’s why we’re currently only hiring people based in Naarm/Melbourne and surrounding areas.

Here’s some of what you can expect:

  • Smart, passionate people who care about what they make.

  • Generous leave and parental policies.

  • Flexibility and genuine autonomy over your time.

  • A great CBD office with a rooftop, gym and personal trainer.

  • A budget for personal development, training and conferences.

  • An Employee Assistance Program.

  • Home loan rebates (conditions apply).

  • Ongoing bonus and equity grants (conditions apply).

Unsure if you tick every box? Throw your hat in the ring anyway. We value different experiences and perspectives, so we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. You might be just who we’re looking for.
